text:
matt: starting staged rollout for inference-runtime v2.5.2 in change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. plan = 2% canary -> 8% -> 25% with 12m holds. release notes: https://internal/release-notes/2.5.2 (kv client backoff + batching improvements). quick stop/go here pls.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by @matt
Command: `/deploy start --service=inference-runtime --version=v2.5.2 --strategy=staged --steps=2,8,25 --window=01:00-03:00UTC`
Status: canary 2% rolling to regional subsets.

rebecca-eng: noticing a small uptick in user-facing 5xx from us-east-1 ~2m after cutover, p50 fine but p95 and p99 increased. grabbing traces. :thinking_face:

kai-sre: seeing auth_error_count increase in us-east and a subtle spike in kv_client_retries. correlating timeline.

infra-bot: Alert: us-east-1 infra_5xx_rate > threshold (0.4%)

matt: proposal: target pin us-east to v2.5.1 and hold next step. others continue at 2%. thoughts?

rebecca-eng: vote: pin us-east, continue others. I'll attach a trace snapshot to the ticket.

kai-sre: vote: pin us-east. looks like our new backoff changes are surfacing a retry storm under certain auth latencies. want to avoid rolling that wider.

ops-riley: we can do region-level re-pin via routing API. example below — will run if we get consensus.

```
# Ops routing pin example
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing/pin \
  -d '{"service":"inference-runtime","region":"us-east-1","version":"v2.5.1"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

ops-riley: also we have a canary abort flag: `/deploy abort --id=...` if we need global rollback.

erin-pm: vote: pin us-east. please notify support if hold extends >20m. I'll post a short update to #release-updates.

deploy-bot: Routing pin requested by @ops-riley for us-east-1 -> v2.5.1. status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Routing pin completed: us-east-1 -> v2.5.1. propagation confirmed.

matt: confirmed us-east pinned back to v2.5.1. global canary remains 2% in other regions. pausing the 8% rollout. healthcheck window starts (+12m).

kai-sre: adjusting alert thresholds and increasing trace sampling for the hold window. watchlist: infra_5xx_rate, kv_client_retries, auth_error_rate, p99 latency.

rebecca-eng: running a traffic-replay test against v2.5.2 with auth latency injection to reproduce. will post results in ~18m.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance in ap-south region in 6h - keep in mind for tomorrow's rollouts.

matt: decision: targeted repin for us-east -> v2.5.1, continue cautious 2% in other regions, cancel 8% step until triage complete. contingency: abort + full rollback to v2.5.1 if similar signals elsewhere. reopen thread with triage outcome. :white_check_mark:
